description: The pie chart titled “Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)” depicts how tokens are distributed across routing destinations, showing three slices in total. The largest slice is labeled “LOCAL,” colored green, and occupies approximately 94.5% of the chart, with its percentage printed inside the slice. A smaller red slice labeled “LLM” represents about 3.9%, also with an internal percentage label. The smallest slice is labeled “EDGE_P2P,” colored blue, and accounts for roughly 1.6%, with its percentage shown inside the slice as well. The chart uses direct labels near the slices rather than a separate legend, and the slices appear slightly separated by thin white boundaries, with no clearly exploded or offset segment beyond the visible spacing.
